messages:
maria: Heads-up — zephyr-12b (quant int4) that went live on Dedicated yesterday is showing token-level repetition on developer code completions and a ~2x increase in p99 for >2k token contexts. Reproducible in staging and prod canary.

leo: ugh, any sample outputs + perf numbers?

maria: sample (call via hosted-canary):
```
> curl -s -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/models/zephyr-12b:generate -d '{"prompt":"Write a function to parse CSV in python"}' | jq -r .text
def parse_csv(file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    rows = []
    for line in lines:
        cols = line.strip().split(',')
        rows.append(cols)
    return rows

# then it repeats: the the the the the the the the the the the the the the the
```

maria: infra logs show frequent KV cache eviction messages around the same time:
```
2026-03-15T18:23:05.421Z [runtime] WARN kv_cache_evicted model=zephyr-12b node=gpu-42 evicted_bytes=14.7MB
2026-03-15T18:23:05.793Z [runtime] DEBUG kvcache-alloc failed alloc_bytes=2048 reason=fragmentation
2026-03-15T18:23:06.120Z [scheduler] INFO batch_window=8 active_calls=6
```

ajay: I see two buckets: either quantization introduced numerical instability that causes attention distribution collapse (hence repetition) or the runtime kernel selection for int4 on that CUDA/driver combo is falling back to a slow/memory-heavy path causing thrashing and evictions. GPU util low?

maria: GPU util on canary was surprisingly low (~34%) during p99 spikes, memory jittered ~86-95% and we got OOM-ish evictions but not full OOM. Throughput down ~22% vs float16 baseline for same batch mix. p50 stable, p95->p99 regressed a lot.

leo: Can you paste the exact launch config we used? specifically quant profile + compiler flags.

maria: here:
```yaml
model: zephyr-12b
quant: int4
quant_profile: {
  method: 'gptq',
  group_size: 128,
  per_channel: true
}
compiler_flags: '--use_fast_kernels --kernel_selector=v2'
runtime: dedicated-a100-v4
```

maria: reproduce command for staging (short):
```bash
python tests/e2e_call.py --model zephyr-12b --quant int4 --prompt-file tests/prompts/code_small.txt --seq-len 2048 --iter 50
```

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: zephyr-12b (quant int4) canary started by @maria at 2026-03-15T17:45:12Z — commit: d8a4b3c — route: dedicated-canary-3

eva: two quick asks: 1) re-run the eval harness with the deterministic seed and check distribution of attention entropies across layers (we saw this pattern before when 4-bit quantization raised softmax temperature). 2) try same quant artifact but with kernel_selector=v1 (older kernels) — kernel selector changes have produced subtle perf/quality diffs.

ajay: I'll grab scheduler and memory traces. Initial suspicion: allocator fragmentation + popping between pinned/kcache allocations. If the kernel emits a larger temporary tensor for some sequence lengths that could trigger eviction cascades. I'll run trace on the canary node.

leo: I'll run a small bisect: int8 baseline -> int4 (gptq group 128) -> int4 (group 64) -> int4 (per-tensor). Also run eval suite for code completion regression and long-context repetition tests.

maria: action items agreed:
- ajay: collect runtime traces and scheduler logs, look for allocator fragmentation & kernel fallback (ETA 2h)
- leo: bisect quant configs + run evals (ETA 3h)
- eva: try kernel_selector=v1 repro and run attention-entropy check (ETA 2h)
- maria: prepare rollback plan to int8 canary if regressions persist (will coordinate with ops-oncall)

ops-oncall: pinged — I'll stand by for rollback. If p99 stays >1.5x after fixes, proceed with canary rollback and stop routing.

maria: small perf numbers from last run: baseline fp16 throughput=480 tokens/s, int4 canary=378 tokens/s, p99 latency baseline=120ms -> canary=260ms on 2k context.

leo: good to know. If group_size=64 helps, we can update quant artifact quickly. If not, fallback to int8 for now and schedule deeper model-quant re-run.

ajay: found kernel fallback logs on node gpu-42: "kernel_selector: no optimized_kernel for seq_len>1024, falling back to generic_gemm". That matches the p99 cliffs at long contexts. Also observed repeated small frees and allocs (~15-20k allocations over short window).

maria: ok let's proceed: leo, eva, ajay do investigations. If any of you get a clear signal that it's kernel fallback causing eviction -> trigger rollback. I'll keep the canary paused for new traffic.

leo: update in ~2.5h — running bisect now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ajay: tracing + heap profile uploading to: https://internal.redwood/runs/zephyr/trace-1793502460

eva: I'll try kernel_selector=v1 on staging and post results. If v1 fixes p99 but int4 still repeats, then we know quant noise also plays a role.

maria: thanks team. leaving notes in the model onboarding ticket and the canary run. tagging this thread for follow-up after investigations. :eyes:
